metadata.question: Was the mean NDSI for Mount Fuji in December 2020 lower than in any other December from 2005 to 2015?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use MODIS MCD43A4 BRDF-corrected reflectance (robust globally, daily 16-day products).
- Compute NDSI = (GREEN - SWIR1) / (GREEN + SWIR1) for December windows.
- Location: Mount Fuji summit point buffered 15 km.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Use simple reflectance validity mask: GREEN and SWIR1 within (0, 10000) to avoid fill/invalid values. No explicit cloud mask needed due to BRDF-corrected product; monthly averaging mitigates outliers.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check ImageCollection size for each period; if 0 after fallback -> C1.
- Check valid pixel count after masking; if 0 -> C2.
- Check mean within [-1, 1] and not null/NaN -> else C3.
- Compare Dec 2020 mean to min of Dec 2005–2015 valid means; strictly less -> A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const roi = ee.Geometry.Point([138.7274, 35.3606]).buffer(15000);
    const scale = 1000;

    // Helper: select appropriate bands for 006/061 and compute NDSI with validity mask
    function addNDSI(img) {
      const bnames = img.bandNames();
      const hasGREEN = bnames.contains('GREEN');
      const hasSWIR1 = bnames.contains('SWIR1');
      // Fallback band names for 006
      const green = ee.Image(ee.Algorithms.If(hasGREEN, img.select('GREEN'), img.select('Nadir_Reflectance_Band4')));
      const swir1 = ee.Image(ee.Algorithms.If(hasSWIR1, img.select('SWIR1'), img.select('Nadir_Reflectance_Band6')));
      const valid = green.gt(0).and(green.lt(10000)).and(swir1.gt(0)).and(swir1.lt(10000));
      const ndsi = green.subtract(swir1).divide(green.add(swir1)).rename('ndsi').updateMask(valid);
      return ndsi.copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']);
    }

    function monthWindow(year, month) {
      const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, month, 1);
      const end = start.advance(1, 'month');
      return [start, end];
    }

    // Build monthly stats dictionary for a given December
    function monthlyStats(year) {
      year = ee.Number(year);
      const win = monthWindow(year, 12);
      const start = ee.Date(win[0]);
      const end = ee.Date(win[1]);
      const col061 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD43A4').filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(roi);
      const size061 = col061.size();
      const col006 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD43A4').filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(roi);
      const size006 = col006.size();
      const usedCol = ee.ImageCollection(ee.Algorithms.If(size061.gt(0), col061, col006));
      const datasetStr = ee.String(ee.Algorithms.If(size061.gt(0), 'MODIS/061/MCD43A4', 'MODIS/006/MCD43A4'));
      const imgs = usedCol.size();

      const ndsiCol = usedCol.map(addNDSI);
      const ndsiImg = ndsiCol.mean();

      const meanDict = ndsiImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      const countDict = ndsiImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });

      const mean = ee.Number(meanDict.get('ndsi'));
      const count = ee.Number(countDict.get('ndsi'));

      return ee.Dictionary({
        year: year,
        images: imgs,
        dataset: datasetStr,
        mean: mean,
        count: count
      });
    }

    // Prepare years
    const baseYears = ee.List.sequence(2005, 2015);
    const baseStatsList = baseYears.map(function (y) { return monthlyStats(y); });
    const stats2020 = monthlyStats(2020);

    // Fetch results (single round-trip)
    const baseStats = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      ee.List(baseStatsList).getInfo((res, err) => err ? reject(err) : resolve(res));
    });
    const s2020 = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      stats2020.getInfo((res, err) => err ? reject(err) : resolve(res));
    });

    // 2. Data checks and concise evidence prints
    // Check for empty collections (C1)
    const baseEmptyYears = baseStats.filter(s => s.images === 0);
    const allBaseEmpty = baseEmptyYears.length === baseStats.length;
    if (s2020.images === 0 || allBaseEmpty) {
      baseStats.forEach(s => {
        console.log(`Dec${s.year} Images: ${s.images}`);
      });
      console.log(`Dec2020 Images: ${s2020.images}`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // Print per-year evidence
    baseStats.forEach(s => {
      const meanStr = (s.mean === null || isNaN(s.mean)) ? 'null' : s.mean.toFixed(3);
      console.log(`Dec${s.year} Images: ${s.images}, ValidPix: ${s.count || 0}, MeanNDSI: ${meanStr}`);
    });
    const mean2020Str = (s2020.mean === null || isNaN(s2020.mean)) ? 'null' : s2020.mean.toFixed(3);
    console.log(`Dec2020 Images: ${s2020.images}, ValidPix: ${s2020.count || 0}, MeanNDSI: ${mean2020Str}`);

    // 3. Valid pixel checks (C2)
    const baseValid = baseStats.filter(s => (s.count || 0) > 0);
    if ((s2020.count || 0) === 0 || baseValid.length === 0) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation failure checks (C3) and validity range
    function inRange(val) {
      return val !== null && !isNaN(val) && val >= -1 && val <= 1;
    }
    const baseValidVals = baseValid
      .map(s => ({ year: s.year, mean: s.mean }))
      .filter(o => inRange(o.mean));
    if (!inRange(s2020.mean) || baseValidVals.length === 0) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Compute baseline minimum
    let minBase = baseValidVals[0];
    baseValidVals.forEach(o => {
      if (o.mean < minBase.mean) minBase = o;
    });

    console.log(`Baseline Min Dec MeanNDSI: ${minBase.mean.toFixed(3)} (Year ${minBase.year})`);
    console.log(`Dec2020 MeanNDSI: ${s2020.mean.toFixed(3)}`);

    // 5. Final Answer: strictly lower?
    if (s2020.mean < minBase.mean) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
